title: Germany news: Over 60s take month of sick leave per year
summary: In total, workers took an average of 15 days off per year due to sickness. Meanwhile, carneval season is beginning in the Rhineland. DW has more.

image.caption: The Left party called the high figures a 'warning sign' about the government's retirement plansImage: Sina Schuldt/dpa/picture alliance
